intervals.label: collaboration: under construction at the PSI ultracold neutron source
intervals.note: Start is the date of the design report, which says the experiment is "currently under construction"; the construction start itself is not stated. End: first use of the n2EDM apparatus for ultracold-neutron measurements (arXiv:2511.06884, 10 Nov 2025).
intervals.quote: We present the design of a next-generation experiment, n2EDM, currently under construction at the ultracold neutron source at the Paul Scherrer Institute (PSI)

intervals.label: collaboration: commissioning
intervals.note: Start is a lower bound (the first paper using the apparatus for UCN measurements, 10 November 2025); the January 2026 paper says the experiment "is currently being commissioned". The active magnetic shield was commissioned in 2021 (same paper). No EDM result has been published.
intervals.quote: which is currently being commissioned at the ultracold neutron (UCN) source
